label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y esta torá de sacrificio de los pazes que acercará a Jehová.
spanish: Y esta ley de sacrificio de las paces que acercará a Jehová.
grammarChanges: Translated תּוֹרַת (fail finding, h03007011002) to the Spanish common noun 'ley' instead of leaving it as the untranslated lemma 'torá'.
Corrected 'los pazes' to the standard Spanish feminine plural 'las paces' (warn finding, h03007011004): paz is feminine (la paz), and its plural is spelled paces, not pazes.
